correctness.rationale: For CΓ the reduced union of m lines through p with spanning tangent directions Γ⊂P², a closed immersion into X surjects local and associated-graded rings, so the reduced projectivized tangent cone Γ embeds in Y_q⊂P(T_qX) with containing tangent plane Π≅P². A normal toric surface singularity in char0 is a rational cyclic quotient and CM with multiplicity e-1 (Artin). CM minimal-multiplicity associated graded has quadratic defining ideal (Sally). If six tangent directions impose six independent conic conditions, every quadratic of Y_q vanishes identically on Π, forcing Π⊂Y_q although dim Y_q=1, contradiction. The explicit six evaluation rows have exact determinant 7, showing nonempty open generic locus. General 3<=m<=5 tangent points lie on a smooth conic and their projective cone P(1,1,2) supplies a closed embedding. Independent fraction Gaussian elimination verifies determinant7. The universal nonembedding depends on classical geometric lemmas, not the one finite determinant witness alone.
